top_news.title: Reverse Item Response Theory for Sparsity-Robust Ranking in Fragmented Cancer Drug-Response Matrices
top_news.dek: Researchers apply reverse Item Response Theory to pharmacogenomics to rank cancer drug sensitivity.
top_news.brief: By modeling cancer types as subjects with resistance traits and drugs as items with evasion difficulty, this approach addresses sparsity in fragmented drug-response datasets. The model provides a robust ranking system for drug activity across diverse cancer types.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing latent trait modeling for drug-response matrices

top_news.title: Uber Eats Rebuilds Search Pipeline to Cut End-to-End Latency by 50%
top_news.dek: Uber Eats reduced search latency by 50% through pipeline re-engineering and infrastructure optimization.
top_news.brief: The overhaul included parallel hydration, redesigned advertising data, and reduced retrieval overhead. The team is now exploring advanced techniques like microbatching and HTTP multipart streaming to further improve performance.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing latency reduction in search pipeline

top_news.title: AI Gateway, Web Search API - Introducing Web Search API
top_news.dek: Cloudflare launches a beta Web Search API for AI agents to ground responses in real-time data.
top_news.brief: The API integrates with AI Gateway and supports providers including Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. All providers offer Zero Data Retention and adhere to verified bot crawling standards, enabling developers to bypass training cutoffs.
top_news.image_alt: Cloudflare Web Search API architecture diagram

top_news.title: Greg Kroah-Hartman – Security in the LLM Age [video]
top_news.dek: Greg Kroah-Hartman discusses the evolving security landscape and threat vectors introduced by LLM integration in software systems.
top_news.brief: In this Kernel Recipes presentation, Greg Kroah-Hartman examines the security implications of integrating large language models into existing infrastructure. The talk focuses on identifying new attack surfaces and the challenges of maintaining system integrity when LLMs are part of the development or runtime stack.
top_news.image_alt: Greg Kroah-Hartman speaking at Kernel Recipes

top_news.title: NVIDIA Announces DGX Spark 64GB: A 1-PetaFLOP Grace Blackwell Desktop for Local AI Agents, Fine-Tuning, and Inference
top_news.dek: NVIDIA introduces a 64GB configuration of the DGX Spark desktop, featuring Grace Blackwell architecture for local AI development.
top_news.brief: The new DGX Spark 64GB desktop system is designed for local AI agent development, fine-tuning, and inference. It supports clustering two units to achieve 128GB of aggregate memory, providing a scalable hardware path for developers working with resource-intensive models.

primary.title: AWS Strands Labs Releases Strands Decider 2B: An Open Source Decision Model That Picks Options in About 115 ms
primary.summary: AWS's Strands Agents team released Strands Decider 2B, an Apache-2.0 decision model built on Qwen3.5-2B-Base. It returns choices, yes/no probabilities and scores with calibrated confidence in one forward pass, never text. It runs at a 115 ms median on an RTX 3090 and scores 0.723 on the JevBench public set, which makes it a fast local option for routing, tool selection and guardrails in AI agents.
